/login 账密登录页：无 header/footer 的 (auth) 布局；validateSearch 读取 from/utm_source/hichatToken/c/inviteCode（from 只取当前 public pathname）；账号输入支持邮箱/手机号（手机号含国家码选择器）blur 校验；密码过滤非法字符；提交先跑极验，2FA 关闭时 login_in 后直接 confirm_login(type=google, authCode=空)，开启时进验证码弹窗；成功后写 session、PostHog 埋点、跳 from||HOME；失败按 code+loginFailNum/seconds/hours 提示；已登录访问 /login 重定向。

验证码、Session 与错误反馈闭环：CodeVerifyDialog 登录场景用 OperationTypeEnum.EmailLogin/PhoneLogin，6 位自动提交、60s 重发倒计时、错误标红；VerifyMan 在 doneVerify 前重置 authPassed=false 防重复触发；confirmLogin 成功拿 quicktoken+uid 写 session 并 invalidateQueries 刷新登录态。
扫码登录 UI：/login 左侧二维码区；加载时请求 get_login_qrcode_id 生成二维码、60s 本地过期；WS 或轮询 get_login_qrcode_status，成功后取 token 写 session 并跳转；过期显示刷新按钮重新获取。

/register 注册页 CreateAccount 步骤：validateSearch 读取 account/c/inviteCode/utm_source；账号输入与登录共用 AccountInput；服务条款默认勾选（同 legacy）；邀请码可折叠输入、URL 带 c 时预填且禁用；点击创建跑极验 → reg_email_chk_info/reg_mobile_chk_info → 进验证码步骤；页面含奖励侧边栏 RegisterSidebar。

注册验证码确认与密码设置：验证码通过后进 CreatePassword；密码必须满足 8-20 位、字母、数字、特殊符号并实时展示 PasswordRuleChecklist；提交 set_email_password/set_mobile_password（密码加密）；成功后写 session、PostHog register_complete（有邀请码时 share_register_success）、跳 from||HOME。

三方登录基础设施 6 项修复（page-migration.md TODO）：① HiChat 回跳 validateSearch 同时识别 grant_token/GRANT_TOKEN/gToken 统一收敛 gToken；② hichatUserStatusQuery 失败要有错误反馈；③ CreateByThird 的 mobileOrEmailNumber 必须 encryptPasswordWithKey；④ VerifyMan authPassed 翻转先重置 false、UniteByThird 传 confirming pending 禁用；⑤ createDesc 用 {{thirdName}} 插值不写死 Apple；⑥ Google GSI 叠层补 clip-path+opacity。

findings.message: E-33 is declared kind=component-dom but its argv runs a component-size/line-count quality script (scripts/quality/tr-02386/component-size.mjs) across ~31 .tsx surfaces to evidence R-021's ≤300-line rule. R-021's static line-count constraint should be evidenced with a directed-quality/static-scan command whose kind matches (as E-51 does), not mislabeled as component-dom.

findings.message: R-021 states an 'all/every' constraint (所有新增 .tsx 单文件 ≤300 行) and models it as an explicit-set of exactly 12 surfaces (S-065…S-076), but the plan introduces additional new/modified .tsx components governed by this rule that are not enumerated in R-021's affectedSurfaces. Missing members include the core login form components (LoginForm/InputAccount, present as S-022 — explicitly the '复杂表单拆分子组件' called out in the source), the MailBinder component (S-035), and the main-header login/register entry (S-036). Under an all/every collection, every .tsx member must be enumerated so a missed component fails coverage; the current collection is incomplete/ambiguous.

E-33 is declared kind=component-dom but its argv runs a component-size/line-count quality script (scripts/quality/tr-02386/component-size.mjs) across ~31 .tsx surfaces to evidence R-021's ≤300-line rule. A line-count scan verifies neither DOM contract nor rendered component behavior, so the kind does not plausibly match the argv, and it functions as a broad quality sweep rather than scoped DOM evidence. R-021's static line-count constraint should be evidenced with a directed-quality/static-scan command whose kind matches (as E-51 does), not mislabeled as component-dom.

reviewAdjudication.reason: 人工裁定：E-33 的 ≤300 行门禁是对组件源码的契约扫描（与 component-dom 类证据脚本同机制——静态读源文件断言组件结构契约），kind 标注之争属分类口径问题，不影响证据有效性；该检查已在 evidence 中真实执行通过。

decisions.reason: component-size.mjs 是组件源码契约扫描，与 E-20~E-31 的 component-dom 脚本同为「读源码断言组件结构」机制；kind 标签不改变其证据效力
